tests.title: Completed stock take records variances and updates inventory
tests.goal: Completing a stock take records counted variances and updates the affected inventory.
preconditions: A staging warehouse and product variant with a known current quantity are available.
data: A controlled staff count for one selected product variant.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and record the current quantity of a suitable test product at a staging warehouse.
Create a uniquely named stock take job for that warehouse and product variant.
Enter a controlled staff count, submit the job, review its variance, and complete the job.
Reopen Inventory and Inventory History for the product.

expected.text: The job progresses through the applicable In Progress, Submitted, Reviewed, and Completed states.
The initial variance equals staff count minus the snapshot quantity.
The completed count is reflected in inventory and a corresponding movement appears in Inventory History.

checks.label: The job progresses through the applicable In Progress, Submitted, Reviewed, and Completed states.
The initial variance equals staff count minus the snapshot quantity.
The completed count is reflected in inventory and a corresponding movement appears in Inventory History.
